Ask about training, progress, or the app
I can help with discovery, navigation, support, brainstorming, and simple planning. Ask a question or choose a prompt below.
Ask for a plan, a quick explanation, or help getting unstuck.
I’m new here. What should I try first in Plainstride?
Help me understand the main setup steps and where to fix things if something feels off.
Brainstorm a few ways this app could better support motivation, exploration, and sharing.
Use what you know about my activity and help me make a simple plan for this week.
Log a workout I already completed
Open Me and tap Add activity to review and save a workout you already completed.
Opening your activity with the goal already set. Tap Start when you’re ready.
I couldn’t apply that change, so your original workout is unchanged.
I’m here to help you find features, understand your progress, and choose a useful next step. Try the activity button for a quick session or open Me to review your history.
I can point you to Today, Social, Me, Settings, activity history, music, or Health. Tell me which one you want to open.
Tell me what you were trying to do and what happened. I can help with account setup, companion settings, Health Connect, music, or activity recording.
We could make your next step easier by choosing a short session, setting a weekly focus, or finding a way to stay motivated. Which direction sounds useful?
Start with a realistic week: one easy session, one focused session, and one flexible session. Adjust the number of days to fit your schedule and recovery.
I can help adapt today’s workout. Tell me whether you have less time, feel tired or sore, or want to understand why this workout was suggested.

User request: %1$s

Use this current Plainstride feature catalog as the source of truth. Do not invent pages or capabilities:
%2$s
See today’s suggested workout, readiness, and quick start.
Find connections, groups, invitations, and shared activities.
Review your profile, progress, recent runs, and personal settings.
Manage account, appearance, integrations, and app preferences.
Change the app’s appearance mode or color theme.
Choose voice, coaching tone, and spoken update frequency.
Manage Health Connect permissions and workout integration.
Connect a music service and choose music for an activity.
Speech recognition is unavailable. You can type your request instead.
Why is this the right workout for me today?
How am I doing right now? Keep it brief and use my live activity stats.
What is one useful thing to focus on for the rest of this activity?
Keep a comfortable effort and use your live stats as a guide. If you feel unwell or unsafe, slow down or stop.
